01 / The brief

WHAT IF
A SODA
HAD A
PERSONALITY?

The idea

POP YOUR imagines a new attitude for the functional soda aisle: expressive flavors, a confident voice, and packaging designed to be recognized before it is read. The concept treats soda as a form of self-expression, giving each flavor its own personality while maintaining one recognizable brand.

Designed with Gen Z in mind, the speculative brand uses personality-led naming, bold color coding, and distinctive flavor combinations to make product discovery feel personal and collectible. Its proposed zero-sugar and prebiotic positioning is conceptual—not a tested product claim.

04 / Design DNAThe visual language

BUILT TO
STAND OUT.

A saturated palette gives each flavor a role. Instead of inventing a new visual identity for every SKU, the system uses one bold wordmark, a consistent can architecture and a signature color for each mood.

06 / Shelf expressionRetail packaging concepts

MORE THAN
A SINGLE.

The packaging system was designed to scale beyond a single can into multiple retail formats. Single-flavor multipacks support repeat purchase around a favorite personality, while the variety pack encourages discovery across the full assortment—extending the same brand architecture into different shopper occasions and merchandising opportunities.

07 / Campaign worldOut-of-home concepts

CITY POP.

One message, many scales. The campaign studies explore how the high-contrast brand system could translate into memorable urban placements without relying on complex creative.
